sources.fact: Regulation 19 HTML lists CF - Castle Green as a site-allocation attachment.
The Regulation 19 decision is plan-making provenance and not an individual Castle Green permission.
LBBD growth-hub material describes a Castle Green concept linked to an A13 tunnel and new station.
The growth-hub page refers to 5,000 homes in a broad concept, not a verified CF parcel capacity.
May 2023 Cabinet minutes describe the wider Castle Green transformation area as potentially delivering up to 12,000 homes, subject to tunnel and station decisions.
The 12,000-home statement concerns a wider transformation area and is not reconciled into the CF allocation parcel.
Cabinet committed to seek a future traveller-site location within strategic Castle Green proposals; this is strategic policy, not a selected legal parcel.
The current official parks page records Castle Green Park, sports fields, skate park, woodland and community uses.
LBBD lists Castle Green Leisure Centre at Gale Street, Dagenham.
LBBD lists current Castle Green community-space use at Gale Street.
Current park/community uses do not define the full transformation-area red line or HMLR ownership.
No exact current residential permission and HMLR parcel relation for the CF allocation was verified this wave.

examples.result: CF allocation identity is retained from Regulation 19 HTML.
The 5,000-home growth-hub concept is not a CF parcel capacity.
The later up-to-12,000 transformation-area statement is kept as a different scope and planning narrative.
The 5,000 and 12,000 figures are not added, averaged or silently reconciled.
Tunnel and station dependencies are preserved.
Current park and leisure uses are not planning consent or title evidence.
Strategic traveller-site commitment is not an exact parcel selection.
Promotion remains zero until exact current case, title relations and overlays are verified.
